home.tagline: Verified cross-border subcontracting — Lithuania to Sweden
home.description: Baltic Bridge proves, with documents and an audit trail, that a Baltic supplier is fully compliant for work in Sweden. Internal ops tool — Phase 0–1.

portal.title: My Baltic Bridge
portal.buyerBody: Your customer account is ready. Requesting quotes from verified suppliers opens shortly — our team can already broker work packages for you: ops@balticbridge.example.
portal.createCompanyBody: Tell us who you are. Our ops team then opens your verification case for the Lithuania → Sweden corridor and guides you through the required documents.
portal.awaitingCase: Profile received — our ops team opens your verification case shortly.
portal.requirementsHint: Upload evidence for each requirement — our ops team reviews every document before approval.
portal.capacityHint: Tell buyers which teams are available — trade, headcount and earliest start. Published listings appear on your public profile.
portal.dispatchedHint: Dispatched to you by Baltic Bridge ops. Submit your offer before the validity date.

suppliers.subtitle: Welding and industrial fitting teams, compliance-verified for work in Sweden.
suppliers.empty: No suppliers match your search yet.

publicProfile.verifiedExplainer: Every fact below is verified by Baltic Bridge ops against original documents — never self-reported.

publicProfile.ctaTitle: Need this team on your site?
publicProfile.ctaBody: Baltic Bridge brokers the work package, checks compliance and keeps the audit trail. Tell us what you need.

requestWork.title: Request work — free and without obligation
requestWork.subtitle: Describe the work package. Our team qualifies your request and dispatches it to verified Baltic suppliers — you compare offers with proven compliance.
requestWork.rfqTitlePlaceholder: e.g. 6 welders for stainless pipework, 8 weeks
requestWork.descriptionPlaceholder: Scope, site conditions, materials, standards (EN 1090…), timing…
requestWork.conciergeNote: No spam, no auto-matching: a human on our ops team reviews every request and selects compliant suppliers.
requestWork.thanksBody: Our ops team qualifies your request and dispatches it to verified suppliers. You'll get an email when offers arrive. An account has been created for you if you didn't have one.
